title: How Uncertain Is My Action? Self-Correcting Visual Planning with Frozen World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23620v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A frozen latent world model combined with sampling-based model predictive control is a visual planner. At deployment, the executed action can depart from the commanded one, and the frozen model has no way to notice. We show that the model can be run in reverse: for any hypothesized actuation shift, it predicts what it should have observed under that shift, and comparing this prediction with what was actually observed quantifies the shift and lets the planner correct itself. Unlike the residual energy, which mixes the shift with the model's own error, the score keeps only the part of the residual that a shift can produce. This shift score detects the shift with a locally optimal test, estimates it with Cramer-Rao error bars, names the dominant generator, and compensates the planner once an alarm fires. On PushT, TwoRoom and OGBench-Cube with a frozen latent world model, measured detection follows the prediction to within 0.05 AUROC. Sel

translated_title: 我的动作有多不确定？基于冻结世界模型的自校正视觉规划
translated_abstract: 冻结的潜在世界模型与基于采样的模型预测控制相结合，构成了一种视觉规划器。在部署时，实际执行的动作可能偏离指令动作，而冻结模型无法察觉这一点。我们展示了该模型可以反向运行：对于任何假设的执行偏移，它可以预测在该偏移下应该观测到什么，将这一预测与实际观测进行比较即可量化偏移，并让规划器自我校正。与将偏移和模型自身误差混杂在一起的残差能量不同，该分数仅保留偏移所能产生的残差部分。这一偏移分数通过局部最优检验来检测偏移，用Cramer-Rao误差棒估计偏移大小，识别出主导生成器，并在警报触发时对规划器进行补偿。在PushT、TwoRoom和OGBench-Cube上使用冻结的潜在世界模型，实际检测性能与理论预测的差距在0.05 AUROC以内。
tldr: 该论文提出将冻结的潜在世界模型反向运行，通过对比假设偏移下的预测观测与实际观测来检测、估计并补偿执行偏移，使视觉规划器具备自校正能力，检测性能与理论预测相差不到0.05 AUROC。
